item.title: A New Force Posture Concept for Europeanizing Extended Nuclear Deterrence
item.description: During the Cold War, Europe kept asking whether Washington would risk an American city to save a European one. item.title: At a Glance: American Quadcopter Component Manufacturing
item.description: The extent of China’s drone dominance — and how to decouple from it — has long been a source of debate and anxiety in Washington. Last month, the Wall Street Journal reignited controversy by publishing a visual analysis of military quadcopter components, exploring China’s advantages in parts manufacturing and cost.
